description: Tapeline's current six-factor score (0-100), signal label, confidence and one-line reason for a single US ticker. It does not return a price or a daily move. Crypto scores come from daily closes, sometimes several days old. Use when asked what Tapeline says about a specific stock. Pass the exact US ticker symbol.

symbol.description: US ticker symbol, e.g. NVDA or BRK.B

name: get_ticker_score
title: Get a ticker's Tapeline score
